scope: Progressive all-I regression check on the field-DCT bitstream; raw captures remain local.

raster_comparison.reason: Entry 644's capture was written to the Buildroot card, which is no longer installed, so no local baseline raster exists for this fixture. These captures are 800x600 scaled from 720x480, so the reference-decode method used for test 1 does not apply without replicating the scaler.
raster_comparison.note: Entry 644 recorded 4,418 mismatches between repeat captures of this same fixture, so the capture-path variation reproduces with a consistent signature.

coverage_argument: Test 1 interlaced all-I and test 7 progressive I/P/B both produced pixel-exact raster matches against released-bitstream baselines, bracketing the paths this fixture exercises.
acceptance_basis: Counter and transport equality with entry 644, plus the user's visual report. Raster equality is not independently established for this fixture.
regression_outstanding: Tests 2, 3, 5 and 6 have not been replayed; they carry the same bar and line content covered by test 1's pixel-identical result.
separate_unresolved_issues: Logic fell 372 ALMs and 912 registers while adding a feature; unexplained.
Setup slack fell 0.117 ns to +0.126 ns on the HDMI domain.
Capture-path variation at x mod 8 == 1 is localised but its mechanism is unidentified.
